title: Home Dimension bags
description: A simple mod that adds new bags that will make you free from your base wherever you are!
body:
__Always wondered to not being tied to your house location? - This mod fixes that problem!__

__What mod actually adds:__

Copper, Iron, Diamond and Netherite home-bags. Thats how they look like:

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/695b6e24c3f5b807b05ed08fdd53a7117831a7a7.png)

__How to use:__

Hold the bag in your fist and press right click. The game will teleport you to your home dimension, which looks like this:

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e2e63d8fb6bbfaf546f887c8be9c49d5589bb84_0.webp)

__How can you attach it to your gaming experience?__

You can use it as your base, safe spot to AFK in, storage or even a farm!

__Whats the difference between bag tiers?__

Copper Homebag has size of 8x8x64.

Iron Homebag has size of 16x16x64.

Diamond has size of 32x32x64.

Netherite has size of 48x48x48 and doesnt burn in lava.

__FAQ:__

Can i transfer mobs to home dimension?
 - __Yes__, to do so you have to hold your home-bag in your fist and Sneak+RMB click on the mob to transfer it your dimension.

Can my friends join my home dimension?
 - __Yes__, but your friends also have to craft additional homebag to enter the dimension.

Will the mod create an additional home dimension if your friend has same bag as yours?
 - __No__, you will be teleported at the same home dimension as your friend.

What if i abuse the homebag to save myself from fall damage or dying to lava?
 - __You can try, but it wont affect anything__. If you fall and use home-bag the game will teleport you, but the speed state from fall with stay with you and you will die inside your dimension. But what with lava? If you teleport to your dimension and then will try to go to overworld the game will bring you back onto the spot you were before switching dimension to home dimension, so you will die to lava.

Can i abuse home dimension to save myself in PvE/PvP?
 - __No__, whenever you're getting hit, the home-bag dimension is set to Combat cooldown that lasts for 5 seconds and it wont let you use it until cooldown is gone.

What if i die in overworld while spawnpoint set to home dimension?
 - The game __will keep__ your home-bag at your inventory even if you die. Dont worry =)
